text:
Maya (AE): Hey team — Novamed wants to kick off a 2-week POC. They asked for SOC 2 artifacts, a network diagram, and a signed pen-test letter before we start. Can we assemble a minimal evidence bundle and an upload method for them?
Devon (Solutions Eng): We have a POC-friendly pack: `soc2-summary.pdf`, `iso-27001-excerpt.pdf`, and a sanitized `network-diagram.pdf`. I can pull those into a ZIP. Need to confirm if they want full scope or just the 'in-scope for hosted API' slice.
Maya (AE): They specifically asked for "SOC 2 Type II summary + pen-test letter". Legal wants a pen-test signatory (vendor-side) on the letter. How long to get that signed? Customer timeline is tight — want it within a week.
Sam (Security): We can produce a pen-test attestation/letter template we use for POCs (`pen-attest-template.docx`) and get sign-off from security leadership. Full redacted pentest reports require NDAs and longer lead time. For a letter (attestation of engagement and date), estimate 3-7 business days if no legal redlines.
Alex (SE): Quick pricing question — Novamed is asking if Dedicated POC changes the quote. Is there a short note on cost delta we can send? (they may prefer dedicated instance during POC for data residency).
Devon (Solutions Eng): Dedicated does shift pricing — around +30% for reserved capacity timeline, but we can offer a short-term POC uplift rate. I'll pull numbers and ping finance.
Maya (AE): Also they asked how to upload evidence. They prefer SFTP. Can we provide presigned upload instead?
Sam (Security): We prefer presigned S3 links or an SFTP presigned window via our secure transfer flow. I can create a presigned upload (48h expiry) and an internal checklist for what to drop in: `proofpack/` contains `soc2-summary.pdf`, `network-diagram.pdf`, `pen-attest-template.docx`.
compliance-bot: NOTE: For external sharing, redact internal IPs and remove build IDs. See /docs/compliance/external-sharing-guidelines.
Maya (AE): Perfect — can we get the presigned upload + a signed pen-test letter draft to hand to the customer by Friday EOD? That gives Novamed time to review before the POC start next Monday.
Sam (Security): I'll draft the pen-test attestation and route to @Alex (SE) for legal check, then to CISO for signature. Target: 72 hours if no legal changes.
Devon (Solutions Eng): I'll assemble the ZIP and upload to the presigned link once Sam creates it. Will include a minimal `readme.txt` with what is redacted.
Alex (SE): I'll run the pricing uplift numbers and confirm dedicated POC quote by tomorrow morning.
Maya (AE): Thanks — keeping Novamed in the loop: "we expect SOC2 summary + signed pen-test attestation + secure upload by Fri". I'll update the deal notes. :thumbsup:
Sam (Security): One more note — if customer insists on signatory from the external pen-test vendor (3rd party), we will need the vendor name and contact; that could add time.
Maya (AE): I'll ask Novamed if vendor-signed letter is required or our attestation suffices.
Alex (SE): Ping me if they ask for SLA changes during the POC, that affects committed capacity and pricing.
Maya (AE): Will do. Thanks all.
